result.summary: The screen is largely intact, but I found 2 minor visual/content issues: a truncated restaurant name in the 'Fastest near you' carousel and the bottom card in 'Popular right now' is partially clipped.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is truncated, so the full name is not readable.
issues.suggestion: Allow the name to wrap to a second line or truncate with a proper ellipsis, and ensure the full name is shown on the detail page.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card (pizza image) is cut off at the bottom edge of the screen, hiding the restaurant name, discount/rating details, and any other info.
issues.suggestion: Add enough bottom padding to the scrollable content so each card can render fully, or include a fade/scroll indicator to show more content is below.
